parameters.query: SELECT COALESCE(changes, '{}'::jsonb) AS changes FROM strategy WHERE active = true ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.id, p.track, p.title, p.image_url, p.product_url, p.offer_url, p.price_min, p.price_max, p.commission_rate, p.commission_amt, p.sales, p.rating_star, p.shop_name FROM products p WHERE p.status = 'new' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scripts s WHERE s.product_id = p.id AND s.status NOT IN ('dropped', 'failed')) AND ((p.track = 'id' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scripts sc WHERE sc.track = 'id' AND sc.created_at >= date_trunc('day', now())) < $1) OR (p.track = 'en' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scripts sc WHERE sc.track = 'en' AND sc.created_at >= date_trunc('day', now())) < $2)) ORDER BY p.score DESC LIMIT 2;
UPDATE products SET status = 'used', updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1;

INSERT INTO scripts (product_id, track, language, voice, title, hook, scenes_json, caption, ai_score, ai_verdict, status) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7::jsonb, $8, $9, $10::jsonb, 'pending') RETURNING id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $('Parse Script').item.json.id, $('Parse Script').item.json.track, $('Parse Script').item.json.lang, $('Parse Script').item.json.voice, $('Parse Script').item.json.title_script, $('Parse Script').item.json.hook, JSON.stringify($('Parse Script').item.json.scenes), $('Parse Script').item.json.caption, $('Evaluate Gate').item.json.ai_score, JSON.stringify($('Evaluate Gate').item.json.ai_verdict) ] }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ id: 'script_' + $json.id, language: $('Parse Script').item.json.lang, voice: $('Parse Script').item.json.voice, handle: $('Parse Script').item.json.handle, scenes: $('Parse Script').item.json.scenes }) }}

parameters.query: UPDATE scripts SET status = 'rendered', media_file = $1, media_bytes = $2, render_seconds = $3, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $4;
UPDATE scripts SET status = 'dropped', error = $1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $2;
UPDATE scripts SET status = 'failed', error = $1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $2;
